name: Mailster

evidence.newsletter: F02: manual campaigns and RSS or post newsletters
evidence.marketing: F02: welcome, birthday and follow-up emails plus visual email workflows
evidence.transactional: F02: can replace WordPress wp_mail delivery, including third-party plugin mail

line: WordPress newsletter campaigns, automations and site email delivery.

free.text: 14-day trial; trial sending quota is not published

cells.api: Yes, local PHP API and SMTP; no public REST API found

subs.math: $79 a year for Starter, split over 12 months + $12 server (2GB) + Amazon SES at $0.16 per 1k emails, with 32 KB per email at $0.12 per GB. 1,000 contacts × 4 sends. Production access; extras and tax excluded.
